points.chapter: 序章 · 科学探究的基本过程
points.defCn: 科学探究通常从观察并提出问题开始，在已有经验基础上作出假设，再设计并实施方案获得证据，最后分析证据、得出结论并表达交流。观察法和实验法是最基本的研究方法。
points.defEn: The scientific method is a systematic way of investigating a question: make observations, form a hypothesis, design and carry out a fair test, collect evidence, analyse the results and draw a conclusion. Observation and experiment are the most basic methods in biology.
points.lcTip: LC 实验设计题按 hypothesis → variables → procedure → result → conclusion 分段写；改变一个自变量时，其余条件必须保持相同，用 "keep all other factors constant" 得分。

points.chapter: 序章 · 显微镜与临时装片
points.cn: 显微镜的使用与临时装片
points.defCn: 显微镜的总放大倍数等于目镜倍数与物镜倍数的乘积。使用时应先低倍后高倍，调节粗、细准焦螺旋使物像清晰。制作临时装片时盖玻片要倾斜放下，以避免气泡影响观察。
points.defEn: The total magnification of a light microscope is the eyepiece magnification multiplied by the objective lens magnification. A specimen is viewed first under low power and then under higher power. A cover slip is lowered at an angle onto a drop of liquid to avoid trapping air bubbles.
points.lcTip: LC 常问 "Why is the cover slip lowered at an angle?"——答案必须写 "to prevent air bubbles obscuring the specimen"；看图计数时记得放大倍数改变，视野直径成反比。

points.chapter: 第1章 第1节 细胞的基本结构
points.defCn: 细胞是生物体结构和功能的基本单位。动植物细胞都有细胞膜、细胞质和细胞核；植物细胞还具有细胞壁、叶绿体和大液泡。细胞壁起支持保护作用，叶绿体是光合作用场所。
points.defEn: The cell is the basic structural and functional unit of living organisms. Animal and plant cells all have a cell membrane, cytoplasm and a nucleus. Plant cells also have a cellulose cell wall, chloroplasts and a large permanent vacuole; chloroplasts contain chlorophyll for photosynthesis.
points.lcTip: LC 比较动植物细胞时用表格式：structure / animal / plant / function；注意 "only plant cells have a cellulose cell wall and chloroplasts"，不要写成动物细胞也有细胞壁。

points.chapter: 第1章 第2节 细胞的生命活动和功能
points.cn: 细胞的生命活动和功能
points.defCn: 细胞能进行摄食、呼吸、排泄、生长、繁殖和应激等活动。细胞核控制遗传与代谢，细胞膜控制物质进出，细胞质是许多化学反应的场所，线粒体释放呼吸作用产生的能量。
points.defEn: Living cells carry out nutrition, respiration, excretion, growth, reproduction and sensitivity. The nucleus controls the activities of the cell and contains genetic material; the cell membrane controls the entry and exit of substances; the cytoplasm is the site of many chemical reactions and mitochondria release energy by respiration.
points.lcTip: LC 结构功能题要写成完整句："The nucleus controls cell activities because it contains DNA"；不要把 respiration 与 breathing 混为一谈。

points.chapter: 第2章 第1节 细胞的分裂和分化
points.defCn: 细胞分裂使一个母细胞形成两个子细胞，染色体先复制再平均分配，保证遗传物质稳定。分化是细胞在形态、结构和功能上产生差异的过程，形成不同类型的细胞。
points.defEn: Cell division produces two daughter cells from one parent cell. Chromosomes are copied and then separated equally so that each daughter cell receives the same genetic information. Differentiation is the process by which cells become specialised in shape, structure and function to form different cell types.
points.lcTip: LC 解释 "Why is mitosis important?" 要写 growth、repair 和 replacement of damaged cells 三点；分化不改变化染色体数目，只改变基因的表达。

points.chapter: 第2章 第2节 生物体的构成
points.defCn: 多细胞生物体的结构层次一般是：细胞 → 组织 → 器官 → 系统 → 个体。形态相似、功能相同的细胞联合形成组织，不同组织按一定次序联合形成器官，多个器官协同完成一类生理功能则构成系统。
points.defEn: The levels of organisation in a multicellular organism are cell, tissue, organ, system and organism. A tissue is a group of similar cells working together to perform a particular function; organs are made of different tissues, and a system is a group of organs working together to carry out a major body function.
points.lcTip: LC 给例子必须分层："heart = organ; circulatory system = system"；单细胞生物没有组织、器官和系统层次。

points.chapter: 第3章 第1节 植物的种子
points.defCn: 种子一般由种皮和胚组成，胚包括胚芽、胚轴、胚根和子叶，有些种子还有胚乳储存营养。萌发需要适宜的温度、一定水分和充足空气，胚根先突破种皮发育成根。
points.defEn: A seed consists of a seed coat and an embryo; the embryo has a plumule, hypocotyl, radicle and cotyledons, and some seeds store food in endosperm. Germination requires water, oxygen and a suitable temperature. The radicle is usually the first part to emerge and develops into the root.
points.lcTip: LC 设计萌发实验时一次只改变一个条件（水 / 氧气 / 温度），其余条件相同，并用 "a suitable control" 说明对照组。

points.chapter: 第3章 第2节 植物的生长
points.defCn: 植物依靠根尖和茎尖的分生组织不断产生新细胞，细胞伸长和分化使根、茎加长加粗。植物需要含氮、磷、钾的无机盐：氮促进枝叶生长，磷促进根系和开花结果，钾有助于茎秆健壮。
points.defEn: Plants grow because meristems at root and shoot tips produce new cells, which then elongate and differentiate. Mineral ions are essential: nitrate is needed for protein synthesis and leafy growth, phosphate for root development, flowering and fruiting, and potassium for healthy stems and disease resistance.
points.lcTip: LC 缺素症题按 ion → function → deficiency symptom 三列作答，例如 "nitrate deficiency causes stunted growth and yellow leaves"。

points.chapter: 第3章 第3节 植物的繁殖
points.defCn: 花的主要结构是雄蕊和雌蕊。花粉从花药传到柱头称传粉，精子与卵细胞结合完成受精，之后子房发育成果实、胚珠发育成种子。植物也可通过扦插、嫁接等进行营养繁殖。
points.defEn: The reproductive parts of a flower are the stamens and the carpel. Pollination is the transfer of pollen from an anther to a stigma, and fertilisation is the fusion of a male gamete with an egg cell. After fertilisation the ovary develops into a fruit and the ovule into a seed. Vegetative propagation allows new plants to be produced from parent tissues.
points.lcTip: LC 区分 pollination 与 fertilisation 必须用一句话写清："pollination is pollen transfer; fertilisation is gamete fusion"；英国/爱尔兰拼写用 fertilisation。

points.chapter: 第4章 第1节 植物的物质运输
points.defCn: 木质部把根吸收的水和无机盐向上运输到茎叶，主要动力来自蒸腾拉力；韧皮部把叶片制造的有机物运输到全株，这一过程称为运输作用。根毛区大量根毛增大了吸收面积。
points.defEn: Xylem transports water and mineral ions from the roots upwards to the stem and leaves, driven mainly by the transpiration stream. Phloem transports the organic products of photosynthesis from leaves to the rest of the plant; this is called translocation. Root hairs increase the surface area for absorption of water and ions.
points.lcTip: LC 常考 "distinguish xylem from phloem"：xylem = water and minerals, upward, dead vessels; phloem = sugar, both directions, living cells。

points.chapter: 第4章 第2节 植物与水循环
points.defCn: 蒸腾作用是水分以水蒸气形式从植物体（主要是叶片气孔）散失到大气中的过程。气孔由保卫细胞控制开闭。水循环包括蒸发、蒸腾、凝结、降水、地表径流和渗入地下等环节。
points.defEn: Transpiration is the loss of water vapour from a plant, mainly through the stomata of the leaves. Stomatal opening is controlled by guard cells. The water cycle includes evaporation, transpiration, condensation, precipitation, surface runoff and infiltration into the soil.
points.lcTip: LC 解释蒸腾速率受哪些因素影响时写 light intensity、temperature、humidity、wind speed，并逐条说明原因，不要只列名词。

points.chapter: 第5章 第1节 植物的光合作用
points.defCn: 光合作用是绿色植物在光下通过叶绿体中的叶绿素，把二氧化碳和水合成葡萄糖并释放氧气的过程。光照强度、二氧化碳浓度和温度都可能成为限制因素。
points.defEn: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants use light energy, absorbed by chlorophyll in chloroplasts, to synthesise glucose from carbon dioxide and water, releasing oxygen as a by-product. Light intensity, carbon dioxide concentration and temperature can all be limiting factors.
points.lcTip: LC 必须会写 word equation 与配平式：6CO₂ + 6H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂；答限制因素题要说 "at low light intensity, increasing CO2 has little effect"。

points.chapter: 第5章 第2节 植物的呼吸作用
points.defCn: 呼吸作用是细胞内的有机物（通常是葡萄糖）在氧的参与下分解，释放能量并生成二氧化碳和水的过程。植物白天和夜间都进行呼吸作用，能量供各项生命活动利用。
points.defEn: Respiration is the chemical process in cells by which food, usually glucose, is broken down to release energy, producing carbon dioxide and water. Aerobic respiration requires oxygen and occurs in mitochondria. Plants respire both day and night, unlike photosynthesis which needs light.
points.lcTip: LC 区分 photosynthesis 与 respiration：前者 store energy，后者 release energy；答题写清 "respiration occurs in all living cells at all times" 这个得分点。

points.chapter: 第5章 第3节 植物与碳氧平衡
points.defCn: 光合作用吸收二氧化碳、释放氧气，呼吸作用、分解作用和燃烧则消耗氧气、释放二氧化碳。两者大致平衡，维持大气中氧气和二氧化碳含量的相对稳定。
points.defEn: Photosynthesis removes carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and releases oxygen, while respiration, decomposition and combustion consume oxygen and release carbon dioxide. These opposing processes maintain an approximate balance of gases in the atmosphere, known as the carbon–oxygen balance.
points.lcTip: LC 用 "relative rates" 解释昼夜气体变化：白天 photosynthesis 快于 respiration，夜间只有 respiration；注意写 "approximate balance"，不要写完全相等。

points.chapter: 第6章 第1节 生物的分类等级
points.defCn: 生物分类等级从大到小依次是界、门、纲、目、科、属、种。分类单位越小，生物之间的共同特征越多、亲缘关系越近；种是最基本的分类单位。
points.defEn: Taxonomy groups organisms into a hierarchy of ranks: kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus and species. The smaller the rank, the more characteristics the organisms share and the closer their evolutionary relationship. Species is the basic unit of classification.
points.lcTip: LC 记忆顺序可用 "King Philip Came Over For Good Soup"；题目给分类树时，共同分类等级越低，亲缘越近。

points.chapter: 第6章 第2节 生物的基本分类单位
points.defCn: 种是能够在自然状态下相互交配并产生可育后代的一群生物。双名法用属名加种加词给生物命名，属名首字母大写、种加词小写，通常用斜体表示。
points.defEn: A species is a group of organisms that can interbreed naturally and produce fertile offspring. Binomial nomenclature names an organism using its genus followed by a specific epithet; the genus begins with a capital letter, the specific epithet with a small letter, and both are usually written in italics.
points.lcTip: LC 命名题必须写对格式："Homo sapiens"；若问为什么不能用俗名，答 common names vary between countries and languages。

points.chapter: 第7章 第1节 藻类与植物的特征及类群
points.cn: 藻类与植物的主要类群
points.defCn: 藻类大多生活在水中，没有根茎叶分化；苔藓植物有茎叶但无真正根和维管组织；蕨类植物有根茎叶和维管组织，用孢子繁殖；裸子植物和被子植物用种子繁殖，被子植物的种子外有果皮包被。
points.defEn: Algae are mostly aquatic and lack true roots, stems and leaves. Bryophytes such as mosses have simple stems and leaves but no true roots or vascular tissue. Pteridophytes such as ferns have vascular tissue and reproduce by spores. Gymnosperms and angiosperms reproduce by seeds; angiosperms produce flowers and their seeds are enclosed in fruits.
points.lcTip: LC 比较类群用 reproduction（spore / seed）和 vascular tissue 两个分类轴；写 moss 时不要说它有 roots，应写 rhizoids。

points.chapter: 第7章 第2节 动物的特征及类群
points.defCn: 动物按有无脊柱分为无脊椎动物和脊椎动物。鱼类用鳃呼吸、生活在水中；两栖类幼体水生、成体可陆生；爬行类体表有鳞片、产羊膜卵；鸟类有羽毛和气囊；哺乳类体表被毛、胎生并哺乳幼崽。
points.defEn: Animals are divided into invertebrates and vertebrates. Fish breathe with gills; amphibians have aquatic larvae and terrestrial adults; reptiles have dry scaly skin and lay amniotic eggs; birds have feathers and air sacs; mammals have hair, give birth to live young and suckle them with milk.
points.lcTip: LC 给"归类理由"时要写可观察特征，例如 "It is a mammal because it has hair and produces milk"，不要只写"看起来像"。

points.chapter: 第7章 第3节 动植物对人类的影响
points.defCn: 人类利用动植物获得食物、纤维、药物和能源，并通过驯化、育种提高产量；同时有害生物会传播疾病、破坏作物，外来物种入侵还会改变当地生态。可持续利用要求在满足需要的同时保护生物多样性。
points.defEn: Humans use plants and animals for food, fibres, medicines and fuel, and have domesticated species through selective breeding. Pests can damage crops and spread disease, while invasive species may disrupt local ecosystems. Sustainable use means meeting human needs while conserving biodiversity for future generations.
points.lcTip: LC 评价影响类题按 beneficial / harmful / management 三段写，并用 "on the other hand" 呈现平衡论证。

points.chapter: 第8章 第1节 真菌
points.defCn: 真菌有真正的细胞核，细胞外有细胞壁，常由菌丝组成菌丝体。真菌不能进行光合作用，通过分泌消化酶分解有机物再吸收营养，是生态系统中的重要分解者；酵母菌可用于发酵。
points.defEn: Fungi are eukaryotic organisms with a cell wall; most are made of hyphae forming a mycelium. They cannot photosynthesise and feed saprotrophically by secreting enzymes onto organic matter and absorbing the digested products. Fungi are important decomposers, and yeasts are used in fermentation.
points.lcTip: LC 要能写 "Fungi digest food externally and then absorb the products"；说明分解者作用时联系 nutrient cycle。

points.chapter: 第8章 第2节 细菌
points.defCn: 细菌是单细胞原核生物，没有成形的细胞核，DNA 位于拟核区，有些还具有质粒和鞭毛。细菌通过二分裂繁殖，在适宜条件下速度很快；多数细菌有益，少数是病原菌。
points.defEn: Bacteria are single-celled prokaryotes: they have no true nucleus and their DNA lies in a nucleoid region, often with small plasmids. Some have flagella for movement. Bacteria reproduce by binary fission and can multiply rapidly under favourable conditions; many are beneficial, but some are pathogenic.
points.lcTip: LC 比较 bacteria 与 fungi 时抓 nucleus 和 cell wall：bacteria have no true nucleus; fungi have a nucleus and chitin wall。

points.chapter: 第8章 第3节 病毒
points.defCn: 病毒没有细胞结构，一般由蛋白质外壳和内部遗传物质组成，必须寄生在活细胞内才能复制。病毒具有宿主特异性，离开宿主细胞后不能独立进行代谢和繁殖。
points.defEn: A virus is not a cell. It consists of a protein capsid surrounding genetic material and can only replicate inside a living host cell. Viruses are host-specific because they must attach to compatible host cells, and outside a host they show no independent metabolism or reproduction.
points.lcTip: LC 问 "Why are viruses not considered living cells?" 答三点：no cell structure, no independent metabolism, can only reproduce inside host cells。

points.chapter: 第8章 第4节 微生物与人类的关系
points.defCn: 微生物在发酵食品、制药、分解废物和维持肠道菌群方面有益，也可能引起食物腐败和传染病。食品保存通过低温、加热、干燥或加盐等方法抑制微生物生长。
points.defEn: Microorganisms are useful in food fermentation, antibiotic production, waste decomposition and the gut microbiota, but some cause food spoilage and infectious disease. Food preservation methods such as chilling, heating, drying and salting prevent or slow microbial growth.
points.lcTip: LC 解释保存方法时写清原理："Chilling slows down the rate of bacterial reproduction"，不要只写"放冰箱更好"。

points.chapter: 第9章 第1节 认识生物的多样性
points.defCn: 生物多样性包括遗传多样性、物种多样性和生态系统多样性。物种丰富度是某一区域物种数目的指标；生物多样性越高，生态系统通常越稳定，抵御环境变化的能力越强。
points.defEn: Biodiversity is the variety of living organisms in an area and includes genetic diversity, species diversity and ecosystem diversity. Species richness is the number of different species present. A higher biodiversity generally makes an ecosystem more stable and more resistant to environmental change.
points.lcTip: LC 定义题写 "the variety of genes, species and ecosystems in a given area" 三个层次，只写 species 会丢分。

points.chapter: 第9章 第2节 保护生物的多样性
points.defCn: 栖息地丧失、过度开发、污染、外来物种入侵和气候变化是生物多样性下降的主要原因。保护措施包括建立自然保护区、迁地保护、人工繁育、立法和可持续利用。
points.defEn: Biodiversity is threatened by habitat loss, overexploitation, pollution, invasive species and climate change. Conservation measures include protected areas, ex situ conservation, captive breeding, legislation and sustainable use of resources.
points.lcTip: LC "suggest three reasons for conserving biodiversity" 可按 ecological、economic、ethical 三类写，确保理由不重复。

points.chapter: 第10章 第1节 生物与环境的关系
points.defCn: 环境中影响生物生活和分布的因素叫生态因素，包括阳光、温度、水、土壤等非生物因素和其他生物构成的生物因素。生物在长期进化中形成形态、生理和行为上的适应，如保护色和拟态。
points.defEn: Ecological factors affect where organisms live and include abiotic factors such as light, temperature, water and soil, and biotic factors such as competition, predation and disease. Adaptations are inherited features, structural, physiological or behavioural, that improve survival in a particular habitat.
points.lcTip: LC 区分 habitat 与 niche：habitat 是"住在哪里"，niche 是"如何生活、利用什么资源"；适应题要写 feature 如何帮助 survival。

points.chapter: 第10章 第2节 生态系统的组成与功能
points.cn: 生态系统的组成与功能
points.defCn: 生态系统由生物部分和非生物环境组成。生产者主要是绿色植物，消费者是各种动物，分解者是细菌和真菌。食物链和食物网表示生物之间的营养关系，能量沿营养级单向流动并逐级减少，物质则循环利用。
points.defEn: An ecosystem consists of a community of organisms and their physical environment. Producers make their own food by photosynthesis, consumers feed on other organisms, and decomposers break down dead material. Food chains and food webs show feeding relationships: energy flows one way through trophic levels and decreases at each transfer, while nutrients are recycled.
points.lcTip: LC 解释 "Why is a food web more stable than a food chain?" 写 "if one species declines, consumers have alternative food sources"。

points.chapter: 第10章 第3节 生物圈是最大的生态系统
points.defCn: 生物圈是地球上所有生物及其生存环境的总和，范围包括大气圈底部、水圈大部和岩石圈表面。它包含森林、草原、荒漠、湿地、海洋等多种生态系统，是最大的生态系统。
points.defEn: The biosphere is the global sum of all living organisms and the environments in which they live, extending through the lower atmosphere, most of the hydrosphere and the surface of the lithosphere. It contains many ecosystems such as forests, grasslands, deserts, wetlands and oceans and is the largest ecosystem on Earth.
points.lcTip: LC 定义 biosphere 时写 "all living organisms and their environments on Earth"；注意它与 ecosystem 的尺度差别。

points.chapter: 第11章 第1节 生态系统的自我调节
points.defCn: 生态系统具有一定的自我调节能力，能通过负反馈使种群数量和群落结构保持动态平衡。这种能力有限，当干扰超过限度时，生态系统可能失去平衡甚至崩溃。
points.defEn: Ecosystems can self-regulate through negative feedback, keeping populations and community structure in a dynamic equilibrium. This capacity is limited: if a disturbance exceeds the ecosystem tolerance, the balance may be lost and the ecosystem can collapse.
points.lcTip: LC 用捕食者—猎物曲线说明动态平衡：猎物增加 → 捕食者增加 → 猎物减少 → 捕食者减少，并强调 "not a constant number"。

points.chapter: 第11章 第2节 生态安全与可持续发展
points.cn: 生态安全与可持续发展
points.defCn: 生态安全指生态系统结构完整、功能正常，能持续为人类提供生态服务。实现可持续发展需要合理利用资源、控制污染、保护生物多样性，并兼顾经济、社会和环境三方面的需要。
points.defEn: Ecological security means that ecosystems remain healthy and functional and can continue to provide ecosystem services. Sustainable development meets present needs without compromising future generations, balancing economic, social and environmental considerations through resource management, pollution control and conservation.
points.lcTip: LC "evaluate sustainability" 题用 economic / social / environmental 三个角度各举一例，最后给出 balanced judgement。

points.chapter: 第12章 第1节 食物中的营养物质
points.defCn: 食物含糖类、脂肪、蛋白质、水、无机盐和维生素六大类营养素。糖类是主要供能物质，蛋白质用于生长和修复，维生素和无机盐调节生命活动，水是所有化学反应的介质。
points.defEn: A nutrient is a chemical substance in food that is needed for energy, growth, repair or the regulation of body processes. The six classes are carbohydrates, lipids, proteins, water, vitamins and minerals. Carbohydrates are the main source of energy; proteins are needed for growth and repair of tissues.
points.lcTip: LC 定义题要给全关键词：class（类别）+ function（功能）+ example（例子）。回答 "What is a balanced diet?" 时须写 "the correct proportions of all the food groups" 并点出 energy 与 health 两个得分点。

points.chapter: 第12章 第2节 食物的消化和吸收
points.defCn: 消化是把大分子食物分解成可吸收小分子的过程，包括物理性消化（咀嚼、搅拌）和化学性消化（酶催化）。吸收是营养物质通过小肠绒毛进入血液和淋巴的过程。
points.defEn: Digestion is the mechanical and chemical breakdown of large, complex food molecules into smaller, soluble molecules that can be absorbed. Absorption is the passage of these digested nutrients through the wall of the small intestine into the blood or lymph.
points.lcTip: LC 常考 "trace the journey of a meal"——用 numbered bullet points 按顺序写 mouth → oesophagus → stomach → small intestine → large intestine，每站写出发生了什么，不要写成长段落。

points.chapter: 第12章 · 教材外延伸（酶）
points.defCn: 酶是活细胞产生的生物催化剂，绝大多数是蛋白质。它能降低反应活化能、加快反应速率，而自身在反应前后不变。酶具有专一性，受温度和 pH 影响，高温会使酶变性失活。
points.defEn: An enzyme is a biological catalyst, usually a protein, that speeds up a chemical reaction in a living cell by lowering the activation energy, without being used up. Enzymes are specific to their substrate and are affected by temperature and pH; high temperatures denature the enzyme.
points.lcTip: LC Unit 2 Enzymes 是必考。定义必须含 "biological catalyst" + "not used up" + "lowers activation energy" 三点。画温度/pH 对酶活性影响曲线时要标轴、标 optimum、解释下降段是 denaturation。

points.chapter: 第13章 第1节 血液的组成和功能
points.defCn: 血液由血浆和血细胞组成。血浆运输营养物质、二氧化碳和尿素；红细胞含血红蛋白运输氧；白细胞吞噬病菌起防御作用；血小板参与凝血。
points.defEn: Blood is a fluid tissue consisting of plasma and blood cells. Plasma transports nutrients, carbon dioxide and urea. Red blood cells contain haemoglobin and carry oxygen; white blood cells defend the body against pathogens; platelets are involved in clotting.
points.lcTip: LC 常以表格题考 "structure + function of blood components"。写红细胞适应特征时列：biconcave shape（表面积大）、no nucleus（多装血红蛋白）、haemoglobin（结合氧）——三点缺一扣分。

points.chapter: 第13章 第2节 血管与心脏
points.defCn: 动脉把血液从心脏送出，管壁厚、弹性大；静脉把血液送回心脏，管壁薄、有静脉瓣；毛细血管管壁仅一层细胞，是物质交换的场所。心脏有四个腔，左心室壁最厚。
points.defEn: Arteries carry blood away from the heart and have thick, elastic walls; veins carry blood towards the heart and have thinner walls with valves; capillaries are one cell thick and are the site of exchange of materials. The mammalian heart has four chambers and the left ventricle has the thickest wall.
points.lcTip: LC 高频："Explain why the left ventricle has a thicker wall than the right"——答 "it pumps blood at higher pressure to the whole body (systemic circulation), while the right only pumps to the lungs"。功能与结构要对应。

points.chapter: 第13章 第3节 血液循环与物质运输
points.defCn: 体循环：左心室→主动脉→全身毛细血管→上下腔静脉→右心房，把氧和营养物质送给组织并带走二氧化碳。肺循环：右心室→肺动脉→肺部毛细血管→肺静脉→左心房，在肺泡完成气体交换。
points.defEn: Systemic circulation carries oxygenated blood from the left ventricle to all body tissues and returns deoxygenated blood to the right atrium. Pulmonary circulation carries deoxygenated blood from the right ventricle to the lungs, where it becomes oxygenated, and returns it to the left atrium.
points.lcTip: LC 注意易错点：pulmonary artery 里流的是 deoxygenated blood（唯一含静脉血的动脉）。答题写 pathway 用箭头串联，名词用 LC 术语，不要中英混写。

points.chapter: 第14章 第1节 呼吸与呼吸系统
points.defCn: 呼吸系统由鼻、咽、喉、气管、支气管和肺组成。气管壁有软骨环保持通畅，内表面纤毛和黏液可过滤异物；肺由大量肺泡构成，是气体交换的场所。
points.defEn: The human breathing system consists of the nose, trachea, bronchi, bronchioles and alveoli. Cartilage rings keep the trachea open; cilia and mucus trap dust and pathogens. Gas exchange occurs in the alveoli of the lungs.
points.lcTip: LC Unit 3 Human Breathing 常画呼吸系统图并标 5 个结构。务必写 adaptation：alveoli 数量多（large surface area）、壁薄（one cell thick）、湿润（moist）、毛细血管丰富（good blood supply）。

points.chapter: 第14章 第2节 呼吸运动与气体交换
points.defCn: 吸气时肋间肌和膈肌收缩，胸廓扩大、肺内气压降低，空气进入；呼气时肌肉舒张，空气排出。肺泡与血液间的气体交换靠扩散完成：氧从肺泡进入血液，二氧化碳从血液进入肺泡。
points.defEn: During inspiration, the intercostal muscles and diaphragm contract, increasing the volume of the thorax and lowering the pressure so air enters the lungs. During expiration, these muscles relax and air leaves. Gas exchange in the alveoli occurs by diffusion: oxygen moves into the blood and carbon dioxide moves out.
points.lcTip: LC 解释气体交换必须写 "down a concentration gradient" 和 "from high to low concentration"，只写 "oxygen goes in" 不给分。扩散距离的关键词：short diffusion distance / steep gradient。

points.chapter: 第15章 第1节 泌尿系统的结构
points.defCn: 泌尿系统由肾、输尿管、膀胱和尿道组成。肾是形成尿液的器官，基本单位是肾单位，包括肾小球、肾小囊和肾小管。
points.defEn: The urinary system consists of the kidneys, ureters, bladder and urethra. The kidney produces urine; its functional unit is the nephron, which is made up of the glomerulus, Bowman's capsule and the renal tubule.

keywords.cn: 输尿管 / 膀胱 / 尿道

points.lcTip: LC Excretion and Homeostasis 要求会画 nephron 并标注。肾单位结构名用英式写法，Bowman's capsule 所有格撇号别漏。

points.chapter: 第15章 第2节 代谢产物的排泄
points.defCn: 尿的形成包括肾小球的滤过作用和肾小管的重吸收作用。血液经肾小球滤过形成原尿，原尿中的全部葡萄糖、大部分水和部分无机盐被肾小管重吸收回血液，剩余液体形成尿液。排泄是排出代谢废物的过程。
points.defEn: Urine formation involves ultrafiltration in the glomerulus and selective reabsorption in the renal tubule. Small molecules are filtered from the blood into Bowman's capsule; glucose, most water and some ions are then reabsorbed into the blood. Excretion is the removal of metabolic waste products such as urea from the body.
points.lcTip: LC 高频题："explain how the kidney regulates water balance"——必须写 ADH（antidiuretic hormone）、collecting duct、more/less water reabsorbed。只写肾小管重吸收不完整。

points.chapter: 第16章 第1节 神经系统的组成
points.defCn: 神经系统由中枢神经系统（脑和脊髓）和周围神经系统组成，基本结构和功能单位是神经元。它能感受刺激、传导兴奋并作出反应，使各器官协调活动。
points.defEn: The nervous system is made up of the central nervous system (brain and spinal cord) and the peripheral nervous system. Its basic unit is the neurone. It detects stimuli, transmits electrical impulses and coordinates the activities of organs.
points.lcTip: LC 用 "neurone"（英式），不要写 neuron。定义题常问 "what is a reflex action?"，关键词：rapid, automatic, involuntary, protective。

points.chapter: 第16章 第2节 神经系统与人体运动
points.en: Reflex action and the reflex arc
points.defCn: 反射是人体通过神经系统对刺激作出的规律性反应。反射弧包括感受器、传入神经、神经中枢、传出神经和效应器五个环节。缩手反射的神经中枢在脊髓，属于非条件反射。
points.defEn: A reflex action is a rapid, automatic and involuntary response to a stimulus. The reflex arc consists of a receptor, a sensory neurone, a relay neurone in the spinal cord, a motor neurone and an effector. Reflexes are protective and do not require conscious thought.

keywords.cn: 感觉 / 中间 / 运动神经元

points.lcTip: LC 必考 pathway 书写：stimulus → receptor → sensory neurone → relay neurone (spinal cord) → motor neurone → effector → response。用箭头，七个环节一个都不能少，写 "withdrawal reflex" 举例。

points.chapter: 第16章 第3节 人体主要的感觉器官
points.en: Sense organs: the eye and the ear
points.defCn: 眼是视觉器官，视网膜上的感光细胞接受光刺激产生神经冲动，经视神经传到大脑皮层视觉中枢形成视觉；耳是听觉和位觉器官，耳蜗内的感受器接受声波振动，经听神经传到大脑皮层听觉中枢形成听觉。
points.defEn: A sense organ contains receptors that detect a specific stimulus and convert it into a nerve impulse. The impulse travels along a sensory neurone to the cerebral cortex, where the sensation is perceived. In the eye, photoreceptors in the retina detect light; in the ear, receptors in the cochlea detect sound vibrations.
points.lcTip: LC 常考 "stimulus → receptor → sensory neurone → CNS → response" 通路。描述视觉或听觉要按光线/声波路径逐步写，并点明形成感觉的部位是大脑皮层，而不是眼或耳本身。

points.chapter: 第17章 第1节 人体的激素
points.defCn: 激素是由内分泌腺分泌、经血液运输到靶器官的化学物质，含量少但调节作用显著。人体主要内分泌腺有垂体、甲状腺、胰岛、肾上腺和性腺。
points.defEn: A hormone is a chemical messenger produced by an endocrine gland and transported in the blood to a target organ, where it regulates a specific process. Examples include insulin from the pancreas and thyroxine from the thyroid gland.

keywords.cn: 胰岛素 / 胰高血糖素

points.lcTip: LC 定义必须含 "chemical messenger" + "secreted by endocrine gland" + "into blood" + "target organ"。比较 nervous 与 hormonal control 是经典题：fast/short-lived vs slow/long-lasting。

points.chapter: 第17章 · 教材外延伸（稳态）
points.defCn: 稳态是机体通过调节维持内环境相对稳定的状态。血糖升高时胰岛分泌胰岛素，促进细胞摄取葡萄糖并合成糖原；血糖降低时分泌胰高血糖素，促进糖原分解，使血糖回升。
points.defEn: Homeostasis is the maintenance of a constant internal environment. When blood glucose rises, the pancreas releases insulin, which causes cells to take up glucose and converts it to glycogen in the liver. When glucose falls, glucagon is released and glycogen is converted back to glucose.

keywords.cn: 胰岛素 / 胰高血糖素

points.lcTip: LC 描述调节过程要用 "when ... rises/falls → ... is secreted → ... causes ... → back to normal" 的因果链，并明确点出 negative feedback。这是 Section C 长答题常见框架。

points.chapter: 第17章 第2节 性激素与青春期
points.defCn: 进入青春期后，睾丸分泌雄激素（睾酮），卵巢分泌雌激素和孕激素，促使生殖器官成熟、出现第二性征，并出现月经或遗精。
points.defEn: During puberty the gonads begin to secrete sex hormones: testosterone from the testes, and oestrogen and progesterone from the ovaries. These hormones cause the reproductive organs to mature and the secondary sexual characteristics to develop.
points.lcTip: LC 内分泌题按 gland → hormone → target organ → effect 四段写。比较 testosterone 与 oestrogen 时用 "secreted by ... causes ..." 的完整句，不要只列名词。

points.chapter: 第18章 第1节 人体的三道防线
points.defCn: 第一道防线是皮肤和黏膜组成的物理屏障；第二道防线是吞噬细胞的非特异性吞噬和炎症反应；第三道防线是由淋巴细胞参与的特异性免疫，包括体液免疫和细胞免疫。前两道为非特异性免疫。
points.defEn: The first line of defence is the physical barrier of skin and mucous membranes; the second is non-specific phagocytosis by white blood cells and inflammation; the third is the specific immune response carried out by lymphocytes, producing antibodies and memory cells.

keywords.en: first / second / third line of defence
keywords.cn: 第一 / 二 / 三道防线
非特异性 / 特异性免疫

points.lcTip: LC Human Defence System 喜欢考 "compare specific and non-specific defence"——用两列表格写：non-specific = immediate, same response to all pathogens, no memory；specific = slower, targeted, memory cells。

points.chapter: 第18章 第2节 疫苗与免疫
points.defCn: 抗原是能引起特异性免疫反应的物质（如病原体表面的蛋白质）；抗体是淋巴细胞受抗原刺激后产生的、能与该抗原特异性结合的蛋白质。疫苗是减毒或灭活的病原体，接种后产生记忆细胞，获得免疫。
points.defEn: An antigen is a substance, often a protein on the surface of a pathogen, that stimulates a specific immune response. An antibody is a protein produced by lymphocytes that binds specifically to that antigen. Vaccination introduces a harmless form of a pathogen so that memory cells are produced.

keywords.cn: 初次 / 二次免疫应答

points.lcTip: LC 常考二次免疫应答曲线：secondary response 更快（shorter lag phase）、更强（higher antibody concentration）、更持久。画图要标清两条曲线。

points.chapter: 第19章 第1–2节 科学饮食 / 行为选择
points.defCn: 健康包括身体、心理和社会适应方面的良好状态。合理膳食、适量运动、充足睡眠、不吸烟不酗酒有助于预防生活方式病，如肥胖、心血管疾病和糖尿病。
points.defEn: Health is a state of physical, mental and social well-being, not just the absence of disease. A balanced diet, regular exercise, adequate sleep and avoiding smoking and excessive alcohol reduce the risk of lifestyle diseases such as obesity and cardiovascular disease.
points.lcTip: LC 新大纲把 health / sustainability 贯穿所有 strand。论述题用 "risk factor → effect on body → prevention" 三段式，避免只罗列名词。

points.chapter: 第20章 第2节 传染病及其预防
points.defCn: 传染病是由病原体引起、能在人与人之间传播的疾病。流行需具备传染源、传播途径和易感人群三个环节；预防对应为控制传染源、切断传播途径和保护易感人群。
points.defEn: An infectious disease is caused by a pathogen and can be transmitted from one organism to another. An epidemic requires a source of infection, a route of transmission and susceptible individuals. Prevention involves controlling the source, blocking transmission and protecting susceptible people.
points.lcTip: LC 答案要把三个环节与三种措施一一配对，用 "source → control; route → block; susceptible → protect" 的对应结构写，最易拿满分。

points.chapter: 第20章 第1节 非传染病与人体健康
points.defCn: 非传染病不由病原体引起，也不能在人与人之间传播，多由遗传、生活方式与环境因素共同作用形成，如近视、龋齿、肥胖、心血管疾病和癌症。
points.defEn: A non-communicable disease is not caused by a pathogen and cannot be passed from one person to another. It usually results from a combination of genetic, lifestyle and environmental risk factors.
points.lcTip: LC 区分传染病与非传染病，先写 "not caused by a pathogen / not passed from person to person"，再举 risk factors 并说明它们如何增加患病风险，因果链要完整。

points.chapter: 第21章 第1–2节 合理用药 / 家庭急救
points.en: Safe use of medicines and first aid
points.defCn: 用药须遵医嘱，注意剂量、适应症和有效期；抗生素只对细菌有效，滥用会导致耐药。急救遵循先确保安全、再判断呼吸心跳、必要时心肺复苏并呼叫救护的原则。
points.defEn: Medicines should be taken at the correct dose and for the correct condition, as prescribed. Antibiotics act only on bacteria and overuse leads to resistance. In first aid, ensure safety first, check breathing and pulse, and call for emergency help.
points.lcTip: 此题在 LC 不单独出，但 antibiotic resistance 是 Science in society 的热门情境题素材，答时点出 natural selection 的作用。

points.chapter: 第22章 第1节 生物的生殖方式
points.defCn: 有性生殖经过两性生殖细胞结合形成受精卵，后代具双亲遗传特性、变异多；无性生殖不经过生殖细胞结合，由母体直接产生新个体，后代保持母体性状。
points.defEn: Sexual reproduction involves the fusion of male and female gametes to form a zygote, producing offspring with genetic variation from two parents. Asexual reproduction produces offspring from a single parent without gamete fusion, so offspring are genetically identical to the parent.
points.lcTip: LC Reproduction 必考对比表：sexual = two parents, gametes, variation；asexual = one parent, no gametes, identical offspring。vegetative propagation 是植物无性生殖的例子。

points.chapter: 第22章 第2节 人类的生殖
points.defCn: 男性产生精子、女性产生卵细胞，两者在输卵管结合形成受精卵，受精卵分裂并着床于子宫，胚胎通过胎盘和脐带从母体获得营养并排出废物。
points.defEn: Sperm and ova are the male and female gametes. Fertilisation occurs in the oviduct; the zygote divides and implants in the uterus. The foetus obtains nutrients and oxygen and removes waste through the placenta and umbilical cord.
points.lcTip: LC 用 foetus（英式），oviduct 比 fallopian tube 常用。胎盘功能题写：exchange of nutrients, oxygen and waste；no direct mixing of maternal and foetal blood。

points.chapter: 第23章 第1节 遗传的物质基础
points.cn: 遗传物质：DNA、基因与染色体
points.en: Genetic material: DNA, genes and chromosomes
points.defCn: 染色体位于细胞核内，由 DNA 和蛋白质组成；基因是有遗传效应的 DNA 片段，是控制性状的基本单位。人体体细胞有 23 对染色体，生殖细胞有 23 条。
points.defEn: Chromosomes are structures in the nucleus made of DNA and protein. A gene is a section of DNA that carries the instructions for a particular trait. Human body cells contain 23 pairs of chromosomes, while gametes contain 23 single chromosomes.
points.lcTip: LC Unit 2 DNA and RNA 要会写 "gene = a segment of DNA that codes for a protein"。区分 gene / chromosome / nucleus 的包含关系是选择题常考点。

points.chapter: 第23章 第2节 遗传信息的传递
points.defCn: 生物性状由成对的基因控制，显性基因掩盖隐性基因。杂合子自交后代基因型比为 1AA:2Aa:1aa，表现型比为 3 显:1 隐。体细胞中基因成对，形成配子时彼此分离。
points.defEn: Traits are controlled by pairs of alleles. A dominant allele masks the effect of a recessive allele. A cross between two heterozygotes gives a genotypic ratio of 1 AA : 2 Aa : 1 aa and a phenotypic ratio of 3 dominant : 1 recessive. Alleles separate when gametes are formed.
points.lcTip: LC Genetic Crosses 必做 Punnett square：写清 parental phenotypes/genotypes → gametes → F1/F2 → ratio。三个比例（genotypic, phenotypic, gamete）别混。这是每年必考的得分点。

points.chapter: 第23章 第4节 人类的染色体组成与性别决定
points.defCn: 人体体细胞有 22 对常染色体和 1 对性染色体。女性为 XX，男性为 XY。卵细胞都含 X，精子含 X 或 Y，受精时精子类型决定后代性别，生男生女概率各约 50%。
points.defEn: Human body cells have 22 pairs of autosomes and one pair of sex chromosomes. Females are XX and males are XY. All ova carry an X chromosome; sperm carry either X or Y, so the sperm determines the sex of the offspring, giving a 50:50 ratio.
points.lcTip: LC 常用 genetic diagram 表示 sex determination，须写出 X / Y 配子与 50% 概率，光写 "father decides" 不给分。

points.chapter: 第23章 第5节 生物的变异与应用
points.defCn: 变异是亲子间及子代个体间的差异，分可遗传变异（遗传物质改变）和不可遗传变异（环境影响）。可遗传变异来源有基因突变、基因重组和染色体变异。
points.defEn: Variation is the difference between individuals of the same species. It may be continuous (e.g. height) or discontinuous (e.g. blood group). Heritable variation is caused by mutation, meiosis and random fertilisation, while environmental variation is not passed to offspring.
points.lcTip: LC Variation and Evolution 要求区分 continuous vs discontinuous 并各举两例；画图时注意 continuous 用 histogram/曲线，discontinuous 用 bar chart。

points.chapter: 第24章 第1–2节 生命起源 / 进化历程
points.defCn: 生命起源的化学进化假说认为原始大气中的无机小分子在能量作用下生成有机小分子，逐步形成原始生命。进化历程遵循由简单到复杂、由水生到陆生、由低等到高等。化石是研究进化最直接的证据。
points.defEn: The chemical evolution hypothesis suggests that organic molecules formed from inorganic substances in the early atmosphere using energy from lightning and UV radiation. Evolution proceeds from simple to complex, from aquatic to terrestrial and from lower to higher organisms. Fossils provide direct evidence for evolution.
points.lcTip: LC 论述进化证据时按 fossil record / comparative anatomy / embryology / biogeography 分点，每点配一个例子，不要只写 "fossils show it"。

points.chapter: 第24章 第3节 生物进化的动力
points.defCn: 达尔文的自然选择学说包括过度繁殖、生存斗争、遗传变异和适者生存。具有有利变异的个体更易生存并繁殖后代，有利基因逐代积累，群体逐渐适应环境并形成新物种。
points.defEn: Natural selection is the process whereby individuals with advantageous inherited variations are more likely to survive and reproduce, passing those alleles to the next generation. Its key points are overproduction, competition, variation and survival of the fittest.
points.lcTip: LC Section C 经典题 "explain how natural selection leads to evolution"——四步链条：variation exists → selection pressure → better adapted survive & reproduce → allele frequency changes。关键词 survival of the fittest 必须出现。

points.chapter: LC Unit 2 · Cell structure
points.defCn: 细胞是生命活动的基本单位。动物细胞有细胞膜、细胞质、细胞核；植物细胞另有细胞壁、液泡和叶绿体。细胞特化形成不同形态与功能，如红细胞、神经细胞、根毛细胞。
points.defEn: The cell is the basic unit of life. Animal cells have a membrane, cytoplasm and nucleus; plant cells also have a cell wall, vacuole and chloroplasts. Cell specialisation produces cells with a particular shape and function, such as red blood cells, neurones and root hair cells.

keywords.cn: 细胞膜 / 细胞质 / 细胞核
细胞壁 / 液泡 / 叶绿体

points.lcTip: LC Unit 2 必考细胞图：动物细胞和植物细胞各画一个、标 6 个结构，并写出特有结构的功能。specialised cell 题按 "structure → adaptation → function" 三点写。

points.chapter: LC Unit 2 · Photosynthesis
points.defCn: 光合作用是绿色植物利用光能，在叶绿体中将二氧化碳和水合成葡萄糖并释放氧气的过程。它是储能反应，为几乎所有生物提供有机物和氧气。
points.defEn: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants use light energy, trapped by chlorophyll in chloroplasts, to convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen. It is an endothermic reaction that stores energy in glucose.
points.lcTip: LC 必背文字方程式：carbon dioxide + water → glucose + oxygen（光能、叶绿素写在箭头上下）。limiting factor 题要会解释 light intensity / CO₂ concentration / temperature 曲线平台期。

points.chapter: LC Unit 2 · Respiration
points.defCn: 细胞呼吸是细胞内的有机物（通常是葡萄糖）在酶的作用下氧化分解、释放能量的过程。有氧呼吸需要氧，产物是二氧化碳和水；无氧呼吸产物是酒精和二氧化碳或乳酸。
points.defEn: Respiration is the enzyme-controlled process by which cells break down glucose to release energy. Aerobic respiration requires oxygen and produces carbon dioxide and water; anaerobic respiration occurs without oxygen and produces ethanol and carbon dioxide in yeast, or lactic acid in muscles.
points.lcTip: LC 常考 respiration 与 photosynthesis 对比表：respiration = all cells, all day, releases energy, exothermic；photosynthesis = green cells, light only, stores energy, endothermic。别把两者搞反。

points.chapter: LC Unit 2 · Diffusion & osmosis
points.defCn: 扩散是分子从高浓度向低浓度自发运动的过程。渗透是水分子通过半透膜，从水势高（溶质浓度低）一侧向水势低（溶质浓度高）一侧的扩散。
points.defEn: Diffusion is the net movement of particles from a region of high concentration to a region of low concentration, down a concentration gradient. Osmosis is the diffusion of water molecules through a selectively permeable membrane from a region of low solute concentration to a region of high solute concentration.

keywords.cn: 高渗 / 低渗 / 等渗

points.lcTip: LC 定义 osmosis 必须同时写 "water", "selectively permeable membrane", "from low solute to high solute concentration"——三点缺一扣分。实验题常考 potato/Egg 在不同浓度蔗糖液中的质量变化。

points.chapter: LC Unit 3 · Ecology
points.defCn: 生态系统由生物群落与非生物环境相互作用构成。食物链表示能量从生产者经各级消费者传递的方向；能量沿食物链逐级递减，约 10% 传递到下一营养级。
points.defEn: An ecosystem consists of a community of organisms interacting with their non-living environment. A food chain shows the transfer of energy from producers through consumers. Energy is lost at each trophic level, with only about 10% passed to the next level.

keywords.cn: 生产者 / 消费者 / 分解者

points.lcTip: LC 新大纲把 sustainability 贯穿始终。画食物链箭头方向 = energy flow（从被吃到吃者），写 "10% law" 解释为何食物链通常不超过 5 级。

points.chapter: LC Unit 2 · Meiosis
points.defCn: 减数分裂是形成生殖细胞时的特殊细胞分裂，染色体复制一次而连续分裂两次，结果一个母细胞形成四个染色体数目减半的细胞，增加遗传多样性。
points.defEn: Meiosis is the cell division that produces gametes. Chromosomes replicate once but the cell divides twice, producing four daughter cells with half the number of chromosomes. Crossing over and independent assortment create genetic variation.
points.lcTip: LC 对比 mitosis / meiosis：mitosis = 2 identical diploid cells, growth and repair；meiosis = 4 different haploid cells, gamete formation。考 "source of variation in meiosis" 答 crossing over + independent assortment。

points.chapter: LC Unit 1 · Scientific method
points.defCn: 科学探究一般包括提出问题、作出假设、设计实验、控制变量、收集数据、分析结论和评估误差。对照实验只改变一个自变量，其余条件保持一致。
points.defEn: The scientific method involves making observations, forming a hypothesis, designing a controlled experiment, collecting data, analysing results and drawing conclusions. In a fair test only the independent variable is changed, while controlled variables are kept constant.
points.lcTip: LC 新大纲 Nature of Science 是贯穿 strand，实验题必问 variables 和 reliability。写答案时用 "independent: ...; dependent: ...; controlled: ..." 分点，并写 "repeat and average to improve reliability"。

units.label: 主题一 化学的魅力
主题二 常见的物质（上）
主题三 物质的组成与结构
主题四 物质的化学变化（上）
LC 衔接专题

points.chapter: 专题1 课题1 开启化学之门
points.defCn: 化学是在分子、原子层次上研究物质的组成、结构、性质及变化规律的科学。它既研究自然界已有的物质，也创造新物质。
points.defEn: Chemistry is the scientific study of the composition, structure, properties and reactions of matter, especially at the level of atoms and molecules. Chemists both investigate existing substances and synthesise new ones.
points.lcTip: LC 开篇题常问 "define chemistry"——必须写 "study of matter: composition, structure, properties and reactions"，只写 "study of chemicals" 不给分。

points.chapter: 专题1 课题1 开启化学之门
points.defCn: 物理变化没有新物质生成，如冰融化、玻璃破碎；化学变化有新物质生成，如铁生锈、蜡烛燃烧，常伴随发光、放热、变色、生成气体或沉淀等现象。
points.defEn: A physical change does not form a new substance and is usually reversible, e.g. melting ice. A chemical change forms one or more new substances and is often irreversible, e.g. rusting of iron or burning of magnesium. Signs include heat, light, colour change, gas and precipitate.
points.lcTip: LC 高频题 "give three pieces of evidence that a chemical reaction has occurred"——写 gas given off / colour change / precipitate formed / temperature change，任写三个，动词用 given off、formed 更地道。

points.chapter: 专题2 课题1 走进化学实验室
points.defCn: 取用固体用药匙或镊子，液体倾倒时标签朝向手心；加热用外焰，试管口不对人；稀释浓硫酸须把酸沿器壁慢慢注入水中并搅拌。实验前先检查装置气密性。
points.defEn: Solids are handled with a spatula or tweezers; when pouring liquids the label faces the palm. Heat using the outer flame of a Bunsen burner and never point a test tube at a person. To dilute concentrated acid, add acid slowly to water and stir. Check the gas-tightness of apparatus before use.
points.lcTip: LC Investigating in Chemistry 常考 safety：写 hazard → risk → precaution（例如 "acid is corrosive; it can burn skin; wear goggles and gloves"），三步缺一扣分。

points.chapter: 专题2 课题2 学习开展化学实验探究
points.defCn: 科学探究通常包括提出问题、猜想与假设、制定计划、进行实验收集证据、解释与结论、反思与评价、表达与交流。控制变量法是设计对照实验的核心方法。
points.defEn: A scientific investigation involves asking a question, forming a hypothesis, planning a fair test, collecting and recording data, analysing results, drawing conclusions and evaluating the method. A controlled experiment changes only one independent variable at a time.
points.lcTip: LC 实验题必写变量三件套 + "repeat and average to improve reliability"。评价题用 "limitation → improvement" 配对写，别只写 "do it again"。

points.chapter: 专题3 课题1 空气的成分
points.defCn: 空气是混合物，按体积分数约含氮气 78%、氧气 21%、稀有气体 0.94%、二氧化碳 0.03%–0.04%，其余为水蒸气和杂质。
points.defEn: Air is a mixture of gases: approximately 78% nitrogen, 21% oxygen, about 1% noble gases and around 0.04% carbon dioxide, with variable amounts of water vapour.
points.lcTip: LC 常考测定空气中氧气含量实验（铜粉/红磷）：写 "oxygen is used up, water rises to 1/5 of the container" 并解释 remaining gas is mainly nitrogen。

points.chapter: 专题3 课题2 氧气和二氧化碳的性质
points.defCn: 氧气是无色无味、不易溶于水的气体，密度比空气略大。它是化学性质活泼的氧化剂，支持燃烧和呼吸，能使带火星的木条复燃。
points.defEn: Oxygen is a colourless, odourless gas, slightly denser than air and only slightly soluble in water. It is a reactive oxidising agent that supports combustion and respiration; it relights a glowing splint.
points.lcTip: LC 必背氧气检验："a glowing splint is relit"。注意 distinguish oxygen 与 air：air 也支持燃烧但木条不复燃。

points.chapter: 专题3 课题3 氧气和二氧化碳的制备
points.defCn: 实验室常用加热高锰酸钾或氯酸钾与二氧化锰混合物、或过氧化氢在二氧化锰催化下分解制氧气。因氧气不易溶于水，可用排水法收集。
points.defEn: In the laboratory oxygen is prepared by heating potassium permanganate, or by decomposing hydrogen peroxide using manganese dioxide as a catalyst. Because oxygen is only slightly soluble in water, it can be collected by displacement of water.
points.lcTip: LC 实验题要会写：why use a catalyst（lowers activation energy, unchanged at end）、why collect over water（insoluble）。装置气密性检查必写。

points.chapter: 专题3 课题2 氧气和二氧化碳的性质
points.defCn: 二氧化碳是无色无味气体，密度比空气大，能溶于水并与水反应生成碳酸。它不支持燃烧、不能供给呼吸，能使澄清石灰水变浑浊。固态二氧化碳叫干冰。
points.defEn: Carbon dioxide is a colourless gas, denser than air and soluble in water, forming carbonic acid. It does not support combustion or respiration and turns limewater milky. Solid carbon dioxide is known as dry ice.
points.lcTip: LC 必背检验："turns limewater milky / a white precipitate of calcium carbonate forms"。写化学方程式时状态符号 (aq)/(s) 要标。

points.chapter: 专题3 课题3 氧气和二氧化碳的制备
points.cn: 二氧化碳的实验室制法
points.defCn: 实验室用大理石（或石灰石）与稀盐酸在常温下反应制取二氧化碳，用向上排空气法收集，因为二氧化碳密度比空气大且能溶于水。
points.defEn: Carbon dioxide is prepared in the laboratory by reacting marble or limestone with dilute hydrochloric acid at room temperature. It is collected by upward displacement of air because it is denser than air and soluble in water.
points.lcTip: LC 解释为何不用硫酸（forms insoluble calcium carbonate coating, reaction stops）和为何不用浓盐酸（gas contaminated with HCl vapour）——这是经典追问。

points.chapter: 专题3 课题2 氧气和二氧化碳的性质
points.cn: 燃烧的条件与灭火原理
points.en: Conditions for combustion and fire control
points.defCn: 燃烧需要三个条件：可燃物、与氧气接触、温度达到着火点。灭火只需破坏其中任一条件：清除可燃物、隔绝氧气或降温至着火点以下。
points.defEn: Combustion requires three conditions: a fuel, a supply of oxygen and a temperature above the ignition point. Fire can be controlled by removing any one of these: removing the fuel, excluding oxygen or cooling below the ignition temperature.
points.lcTip: LC 用 "fire triangle" 图解释，三边写 fuel / oxygen / heat，灭火写 "remove one side of the triangle"。不完全燃烧产物 CO 有毒，是常考情境。

points.chapter: 专题4 课题3 水的组成
points.defCn: 水由氢、氧两种元素组成，化学式 H₂O。电解水时正极产生氧气、负极产生氢气，体积比约为 1:2，说明一个水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子构成。
points.defEn: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen with the formula H₂O. During electrolysis, oxygen is produced at the anode (+) and hydrogen at the cathode (−), in a volume ratio of 1:2. This shows that each water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
points.lcTip: LC 必背 "oxygen at the anode, hydrogen at the cathode; 1:2 ratio；hydrogen is twice the volume"。检验：hydrogen 用 burning splint（squeaky pop），oxygen 用 glowing splint。

points.chapter: 专题4 课题2 水的自然循环与人工净化
points.defCn: 净水方法按净化程度由低到高为静置沉淀、吸附沉淀、过滤、吸附、蒸馏。过滤除去不溶性杂质，蒸馏可得到蒸馏水，净化程度最高。
points.defEn: Water is purified by sedimentation, filtration, adsorption and distillation. Filtration removes insoluble suspended solids; distillation produces distilled water and gives the purest product.
points.lcTip: LC Water 单元常考 water treatment 流程：screening → coagulation → filtration → chlorination。写每步目的，不要只列名词。

points.chapter: 专题4 课题2 水的自然循环与人工净化
points.defCn: 硬水含较多可溶性钙、镁化合物，软水含较少或不含。硬水加肥皂水泡沫少、浮渣多；煮沸或蒸馏可软化硬水。硬水易形成水垢，影响锅炉安全。
points.defEn: Hard water contains dissolved calcium and magnesium ions; soft water does not. Hard water produces little lather and a scum with soap. It can be softened by boiling or distillation and forms scale in boilers.
points.lcTip: LC 高频："how to distinguish hard and soft water"——add soap solution, shake; soft = plenty of lather, hard = scum。写 test + observation + conclusion 三步。

points.chapter: 专题5 课题1 构成物质的微观粒子
points.defCn: 分子是保持物质化学性质的最小粒子，原子是化学变化中的最小粒子。化学变化中分子可分、原子不可再分，原子重新组合形成新分子。
points.defEn: A molecule is the smallest particle of a substance that retains its chemical properties; an atom is the smallest particle that takes part in a chemical reaction. In a chemical change, molecules are broken and atoms are rearranged to form new molecules, but atoms themselves are unchanged.
points.lcTip: LC 必考 "explain what happens to atoms during a chemical reaction"——写 "bonds break and form; atoms are rearranged; no atoms are created or destroyed" 三点。

points.chapter: 专题5 课题1 构成物质的微观粒子
points.defCn: 微粒质量和体积都很小，总在不断运动，微粒间有间隔。温度越高运动越快，间隔越大；气体间隔最大，固体最小。这些性质解释扩散、蒸发和热胀冷缩。
points.defEn: Particles are very small, are in constant random motion and have spaces between them. Higher temperatures increase the speed of particles and the spacing between them. These properties explain diffusion, evaporation and thermal expansion.
points.lcTip: LC Behaviour of Matter 用 kinetic theory 解释状态变化：写 particle spacing + arrangement + motion 三列对比 solid/liquid/gas，比纯文字容易拿分。

points.chapter: 专题1 课题2 通用的化学语言
points.defCn: 元素是具有相同核电荷数（质子数）的一类原子的总称。元素符号第一个字母大写、第二个小写，如 H、O、C、Na、Cl。目前已知元素一百多种。
points.defEn: An element is a substance made of atoms with the same number of protons in the nucleus. Chemical symbols always begin with a capital letter and, if there is a second letter, it is lower case, e.g. H, O, Na, Cl.
points.lcTip: LC 符号书写大小写严格扣分：Co（钴）与 CO（一氧化碳）完全不同。周期表题用 group/period 定位，写全 "Group 1, Period 3"。

points.chapter: 专题1 课题2 通用的化学语言
points.defCn: 化学式用元素符号和数字表示物质的组成，如 H₂O、CO₂、NaCl。元素符号右下角数字表示一个分子中该原子的个数；化学式前面的系数表示分子个数。
points.defEn: A chemical formula uses symbols and numbers to show the composition of a substance, e.g. H₂O, CO₂, NaCl. The subscript shows the number of atoms of that element in one molecule; the number in front of a formula is the coefficient, showing how many molecules are involved.
points.lcTip: LC 必区分 subscript 与 coefficient：2H₂O 中 2（coefficient）= 2 个水分子，下标 2 = 每个分子 2 个氢原子。计算题数原子个数时两者要相乘。

points.chapter: 专题1 课题2 通用的化学语言
points.defCn: 化合价表示原子在形成化合物时得失电子或共用电子对的数目，有正价和负价。化合物中各元素正负化合价代数和为零，据此可写出化学式。
points.defEn: Valency is the combining capacity of an atom, shown by the number of electrons it loses, gains or shares. Elements have positive or negative valencies. In a compound, the total positive and negative valencies balance to zero, which allows formulae to be deduced.
points.lcTip: LC 用 oxidation number 更多。规则题：O 通常 −2、H 通常 +1、单质为 0；写答案时说明 "the sum of oxidation numbers in a compound is zero"。

points.chapter: 专题6 课题1 化学反应中各物质间的定量关系
points.defCn: 参加化学反应的各物质质量总和等于反应后生成的各物质质量总和。实质是反应前后原子的种类、数目和质量都不改变，只是重新组合。
points.defEn: The total mass of the reactants equals the total mass of the products in a chemical reaction. This is because atoms are neither created nor destroyed: their type, number and mass remain unchanged and they are only rearranged.
points.lcTip: LC 解释题必须落到原子层面："atoms are rearranged, not created or destroyed"。涉及气体参加/生成的实验要指出须在 closed system 中做，否则称量结果偏小或偏大。

points.chapter: 专题6 课题2 化学反应的表示及基本类型
points.defCn: 化学方程式用化学式表示化学反应，能表明反应物、生成物、反应条件和各物质间的质量关系。书写步骤：写化学式→配平→注明条件与气体/沉淀符号。
points.defEn: A chemical equation uses formulae to represent a reaction, showing the reactants, products, conditions and the relative amounts of each substance. To write one: write the correct formulae, balance the equation, then add reaction conditions and state symbols.
points.lcTip: LC 配平方程式是必考分：先配 C、H，最后配 O；写状态符号 (s)/(l)/(g)/(aq)。上海新教改"弱化方程式背诵"，但 LC 强调精确——这是两边最大的差异，要重点练。

points.chapter: 专题6 课题2 化学反应的表示及基本类型
points.defCn: 化合反应是由两种或两种以上物质生成一种物质的反应（A+B→AB）；分解反应是由一种物质生成两种或两种以上物质的反应（AB→A+B）。
points.defEn: A combination reaction is one in which two or more substances join to form a single product (A + B → AB). A decomposition reaction is one in which a single compound breaks down into two or more simpler substances (AB → A + B).
points.lcTip: LC 归类题看"反应物个数 + 生成物个数"即可：多变一 = combination，一变多 = decomposition。举例要配平：2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO；2KMnO₄ → K₂MnO₄ + MnO₂ + O₂。

points.chapter: 专题6 课题2 化学反应的表示及基本类型
points.cn: 置换反应与复分解反应
points.defCn: 置换反应是一种单质与一种化合物反应生成另一种单质和另一种化合物（A+BC→AC+B）；复分解反应是两种化合物相互交换成分生成两种新化合物（AB+CD→AD+CB），常在溶液中进行，生成沉淀、气体或水时发生。
points.defEn: In a displacement reaction a more reactive element replaces a less reactive one in a compound (A + BC → AC + B). In a double-decomposition reaction two compounds exchange ions to form two new compounds (AB + CD → AD + CB); it occurs when a precipitate, gas or water is formed.
points.lcTip: LC 判断置换能否发生用 reactivity series：more reactive metal displaces a less reactive one from its salt solution。写 ionic equation 时删掉 spectator ions 是加分点。

points.chapter: 专题6 课题2 化学反应的表示及基本类型
points.defCn: 物质与氧发生的反应叫氧化反应；含氧化合物里的氧被夺去的反应叫还原反应。从电子角度看，氧化是失去电子，还原是得到电子，两者总是同时发生。
points.defEn: Oxidation is the loss of electrons (or gain of oxygen) by a substance; reduction is the gain of electrons (or loss of oxygen). Oxidation and reduction always occur together in a redox reaction.
points.lcTip: LC Redox 用 "OIL RIG"（Oxidation Is Loss, Reduction Is Gain of electrons）记忆。判断题要写清 "X is oxidised because it loses electrons"。

points.chapter: 专题6 课题1 化学反应中各物质间的定量关系
points.cn: 相对原子质量与相对分子质量
points.defCn: 相对原子质量是以碳-12原子质量的 1/12 为标准，其他原子质量与该标准的比值。相对分子质量等于化学式中各原子相对原子质量的总和，没有单位。
points.defEn: Relative atomic mass (Ar) is the average mass of an atom compared with one twelfth of the mass of a carbon-12 atom. Relative molecular mass (Mr) is the sum of the relative atomic masses of all atoms in a molecule; both have no units.
points.lcTip: LC 计算题务必区分 Ar / Mr / molar mass，后两者数值相同但单位不同（Mr 无单位，molar mass 单位 g/mol）。写计算步骤：先列式子再代入，最后写单位。

points.chapter: 专题6 课题1 化学反应中各物质间的定量关系
points.cn: 化合物中元素质量分数
points.defCn: 化合物中某元素的质量分数 = 该元素的相对原子质量×原子个数 ÷ 化合物的相对分子质量 × 100%。
points.defEn: The percentage by mass of an element in a compound is calculated as (Ar × number of atoms of that element) ÷ Mr of the compound × 100.
points.lcTip: LC 常与 empirical formula 结合考：先算各元素质量百分比 → 假设 100 g → 求 mol 比 → 化简整数比。步骤写全，中间结果保留位数。

points.chapter: LC Strand 1 · Atomic structure
points.defCn: 原子由带正电的原子核和核外带负电的电子构成，原子核由质子和中子组成。质子数决定元素种类，质子数=核电荷数=核外电子数（原子呈电中性）。电子分层排布，如 2,8,8。
points.defEn: An atom consists of a small, positively charged nucleus containing protons and neutrons, surrounded by negatively charged electrons in energy levels. The number of protons determines the element; in a neutral atom the number of protons equals the number of electrons. Electrons occupy shells, e.g. 2,8,8.

keywords.cn: 质子 / 中子 / 电子

points.lcTip: LC 必写 electronic configuration 如 2,8,1；题问 "why are Group 1 elements reactive?" 答 "one outer electron, easily lost to achieve a full outer shell"。

points.chapter: LC Strand 1 · Bonding
points.defCn: 离子键是阴阳离子间的静电吸引，通常形成于金属与非金属之间；共价键是原子间共用电子对形成的作用，通常形成于非金属之间。离子化合物熔沸点高、熔融或溶于水时导电；共价化合物多不导电。
points.defEn: An ionic bond is the electrostatic attraction between oppositely charged ions, usually formed between a metal and a non-metal by electron transfer. A covalent bond is a shared pair of electrons between two non-metal atoms. Ionic compounds have high melting points and conduct when molten or dissolved; covalent compounds generally do not conduct.
points.lcTip: LC Strand 2 Bonding 高频：比较 ionic vs covalent 用表格（particles / bonding / mp / conductivity / solubility）。画图题用 dot-and-cross diagram，注意标出电荷。

points.chapter: LC Strand 1 · The mole
points.en: The mole and amount of substance
points.defCn: 摩尔是物质的量的单位，1 mol 物质含约 6.02×10²³ 个微粒（阿伏伽德罗常数）。物质的量 n = 质量 m ÷ 摩尔质量 M，单位 mol。
points.defEn: The mole is the SI unit for the amount of substance. One mole contains 6.02 × 10²³ particles (the Avogadro constant). The number of moles n = mass m ÷ molar mass M, where M is in g/mol.
points.lcTip: LC 化学计算核心工具：n = m/M；用方程式的系数比（mole ratio）换算。答题必须写 "n = m/M" 和单位，只写答案不给过程会扣分。

points.chapter: LC Strand 4 · Acids and bases
points.defCn: 酸在水溶液中电离产生 H⁺，碱产生 OH⁻。酸与碱反应生成盐和水，称为中和反应。pH 小于 7 为酸性，等于 7 为中性，大于 7 为碱性。
points.defEn: An acid produces H⁺(aq) ions in water; a base produces OH⁻(aq) ions. Neutralisation is the reaction between an acid and a base to form a salt and water. A pH below 7 is acidic, 7 is neutral and above 7 is alkaline.

keywords.cn: 酸 / 碱 / 可溶性碱

points.lcTip: LC 必背 ionic equation：H⁺(aq) + OH⁻(aq) → H₂O(l)。滴定时写 "end point indicated by colour change of phenolphthalein/methyl orange"。

points.chapter: LC Strand 4 · Volumetric analysis
points.defCn: 滴定是用已知浓度的溶液逐滴加入待测液，直到指示剂变色达到终点，从而求出未知浓度。浓度 c = 物质的量 n ÷ 体积 V（单位 mol/L）。
points.defEn: Titration is a technique in which a solution of known concentration is added to a measured volume of another solution until the end point is reached, allowing the unknown concentration to be calculated. Concentration c = number of moles n ÷ volume V (mol/L).
points.lcTip: LC 实验题常考操作细节：rinse burette with the acid, read at eye level from the bottom of the meniscus, add dropwise near the end point, repeat to get concordant titres。

points.chapter: LC Strand 3 · Rates of reaction
points.defCn: 反应速率表示单位时间内反应物或生成物浓度的变化。升高温度、增大浓度、增大接触面积、使用催化剂和使用更高freq的光都能加快反应；本质是有效碰撞次数增加。
points.defEn: The rate of reaction is the change in concentration of a reactant or product per unit time. Rate increases with higher temperature, higher concentration, greater surface area and the presence of a catalyst, because these increase the frequency of successful collisions.
points.lcTip: LC 解释影响因素必须用 collision theory 语言："more particles per unit volume → more frequent collisions → faster rate"。只写 "more reactive" 不给分。

points.chapter: LC Strand 3 · Equilibrium
points.defCn: 可逆反应中正反应速率与逆反应速率相等、各物质浓度保持不变时达到动态平衡。改变浓度、温度或压强会使平衡移动（勒夏特列原理）。
points.defEn: Dynamic equilibrium is reached in a reversible reaction when the forward and reverse rates are equal and the concentrations of all species remain constant. Changes in concentration, temperature or pressure shift the equilibrium according to Le Chatelier's principle.
points.lcTip: LC 答题模板："the system opposes the change"——先说移动方向，再说对产率的影响。温度影响要结合反应是 exothermic 还是 endothermic。

points.chapter: LC Strand 2 · Gases
points.defCn: 根据分子运动论，气体分子间距离大、运动快，压强来自分子与器壁的碰撞。玻意耳定律：温度不变时压强与体积成反比；查理定律：压强不变时体积与热力学温度成正比。
points.defEn: According to kinetic theory, gas particles are far apart and move rapidly; pressure results from collisions with the container walls. Boyle's law states that at constant temperature pressure is inversely proportional to volume; Charles' law states that at constant pressure volume is proportional to absolute temperature.
points.lcTip: LC 计算用 P₁V₁/T₁ = P₂V₂/T₂，温度必须换算为 Kelvin（K = °C + 273）。写答案时说明 "at constant temperature / pressure" 的前提条件。

points.chapter: LC Strand 4 · Organic chemistry
points.defCn: 有机物是含碳化合物（少数简单含碳化合物除外）。烃只含碳和氢，分烷烃、烯烃和炔烃；同系物结构相似、组成相差一个或多个 CH₂，化学性质相似。
points.defEn: Organic compounds contain carbon (with a few exceptions). Hydrocarbons contain only carbon and hydrogen and are classified as alkanes, alkenes or alkynes. A homologous series has the same functional group and general formula, with successive members differing by CH₂.

keywords.cn: 烷烃 / 烯烃 / 炔烃

points.lcTip: LC 命名题按 IUPAC：选最长碳链 → 编号（取代基位次最小）→ 写前缀+词根+后缀。烯烃用 bromine water 褪色检验（addition 反应）。

points.chapter: 专题5 课题3 结构多样的碳单质
points.defCn: 金刚石、石墨和 C₆₀ 都是由碳元素组成的不同单质，因碳原子排列方式不同而性质差异很大：金刚石硬度极大、不导电；石墨质软、能导电；C₆₀ 由足球状分子构成。
points.defEn: Allotropes are different forms of the same element in the same physical state. Diamond, graphite and C60 are allotropes of carbon: their atoms are arranged differently, so diamond is very hard and does not conduct electricity, while graphite is soft and conducts electricity.
points.lcTip: LC 结构题必须把 structure → property → use 串起来：graphite 的 layered structure + delocalised electrons → conducts electricity → electrodes；diamond 的 rigid 3D network → very hard → cutting tools。只写性质不给结构理由会丢分。

formulas.expr: 二氧化碳 + 水 ——(光能 / 叶绿体)→ 葡萄糖 + 氧气
formulas.exprEn: carbon dioxide + water —(light energy / chlorophyll)→ glucose + oxygen
formulas.noteCn: 合成有机物、储存能量的过程。LC 里必须写出 light energy 和 chlorophyll 两个条件，缺一扣分。
formulas.noteEn: An endothermic reaction storing energy. Always include light energy and chlorophyll when writing the word equation in LC.

formulas.expr: 有机物（葡萄糖）+ 氧气 ——(酶)→ 二氧化碳 + 水 + 能量
formulas.exprEn: glucose + oxygen —(enzymes)→ carbon dioxide + water + energy (ATP)
formulas.noteCn: 释放能量的过程，与光合作用的反应物、生成物正好相反。ATP 是细胞的能量货币。
formulas.noteEn: Exothermic; the reverse of photosynthesis in terms of reactants and products. ATP is the energy currency of the cell.

formulas.expr: 葡萄糖 ——(酶、无氧)→ 酒精 + 二氧化碳 + 少量能量
formulas.exprEn: glucose —(enzymes, no oxygen)→ ethanol + carbon dioxide + small amount of energy
formulas.noteCn: 酵母的酒精发酵，用于酿酒和面包。 muscle 无氧呼吸产物是乳酸而非酒精。
formulas.noteEn: Alcoholic fermentation in yeast; used in brewing and baking. In human muscle, anaerobic respiration produces lactic acid instead.

formulas.expr: 淀粉 ——(唾液淀粉酶)→ 麦芽糖 ——(麦芽糖酶)→ 葡萄糖
formulas.exprEn: starch —(amylase)→ maltose —(maltase)→ glucose
formulas.condEn: amylase in saliva and pancreatic juice; maltase in small intestine
formulas.noteCn: 淀粉最终分解为可吸收的葡萄糖，在小肠完成吸收。
formulas.noteEn: Starch is broken down to glucose for absorption in the small intestine. LC food tests: iodine for starch, Benedict's for reducing sugar.

formulas.expr: 蛋白质 ——(胃蛋白酶 / 胰蛋白酶)→ 多肽 ——(肽酶)→ 氨基酸
formulas.exprEn: protein —(pepsin / trypsin)→ peptides —(peptidases)→ amino acids
formulas.noteCn: 蛋白质最终分解为氨基酸才能被吸收，用于合成人体自身蛋白质。
formulas.noteEn: Amino acids are the building blocks used for growth and repair. Biuret test detects protein (blue → purple).

formulas.cn: 气体交换 · 扩散方向
formulas.expr: 肺泡(O₂ 高) → 血液(O₂ 低)；血液(CO₂ 高) → 肺泡(CO₂ 低)
formulas.exprEn: alveoli (high O₂) → blood (low O₂); blood (high CO₂) → alveoli (low CO₂)
formulas.formula: 沿浓度梯度：高浓度 → 低浓度
formulas.cond: 肺泡壁与毛细血管壁均一层细胞
formulas.condEn: alveolar and capillary walls are one cell thick
formulas.noteCn: 组织的气体交换方向相反：血液给组织送 O₂、带走 CO₂。
formulas.noteEn: At body tissues the direction reverses: oxygen leaves the blood and carbon dioxide enters it. Always write "down a concentration gradient".

formulas.cn: 一对相对性状的杂交（完全显性）
formulas.expr: P：AA × aa → F₁：全部 Aa（显性）→ F₁ 自交 Aa × Aa → F₂：1AA : 2Aa : 1aa
formulas.exprEn: P: AA × aa → F1: all Aa (dominant phenotype) → F1 selfed: Aa × Aa → F2: 1 AA : 2 Aa : 1 aa
formulas.formula: 基因型比 1:2:1 ｜ 表现型比 3:1
formulas.noteCn: LC 必须画出 Punnett square，写清配子、F₁、F₂ 与两种比例。
formulas.noteEn: LC requires a Punnett square with parental genotypes, gametes, F1/F2 and both the genotypic (1:2:1) and phenotypic (3:1) ratios.

formulas.expr: 未知显性个体 × 隐性纯合子(aa) → 子代全显性则为 AA；出现 1:1 则为 Aa
formulas.exprEn: unknown dominant individual × homozygous recessive (aa) → all dominant offspring means AA; a 1:1 ratio means Aa
formulas.noteCn: 用于判断显性性状个体的基因型。
formulas.noteEn: A test cross reveals the genotype of an individual showing the dominant phenotype.

formulas.expr: 母 XX（配子全 X）× 父 XY（配子 X 或 Y）→ 女 XX : 男 XY = 1 : 1
formulas.exprEn: mother XX (all X ova) × father XY (X or Y sperm) → female XX : male XY = 1 : 1
formulas.condEn: the sperm determines the sex of the offspring
formulas.noteCn: 每次受精生男生女概率均为 50%，与上次结果无关。
formulas.noteEn: Each fertilisation is independent: the probability of a boy or a girl is 50% each time.

formulas.expr: 氧气 O₂ ｜ 氮气 N₂ ｜ 氢气 H₂ ｜ 氯气 Cl₂ ｜ 碳 C ｜ 铁 Fe ｜ 镁 Mg ｜ 铜 Cu
formulas.exprEn: oxygen O₂ ｜ nitrogen N₂ ｜ hydrogen H₂ ｜ chlorine Cl₂ ｜ carbon C ｜ iron Fe ｜ magnesium Mg ｜ copper Cu
formulas.formula: O₂ · N₂ · H₂ · Cl₂（气态非金属多为双原子分子）
formulas.cond: 元素符号首字母大写，第二个字母小写
formulas.condEn: first letter capital, second letter lower case
formulas.noteCn: 稀有气体（He、Ne、Ar）是单原子分子，金属和固态非金属用元素符号直接表示。
formulas.noteEn: Noble gases are monatomic; metals and solid non-metals are represented by their symbol alone. Always write correct case: Co ≠ CO.

formulas.expr: 水 H₂O ｜ 二氧化碳 CO₂ ｜ 一氧化碳 CO ｜ 氯化钠 NaCl ｜ 碳酸钙 CaCO₃ ｜ 硫酸 H₂SO₄ ｜ 氢氧化钠 NaOH
formulas.exprEn: water H₂O ｜ carbon dioxide CO₂ ｜ carbon monoxide CO ｜ sodium chloride NaCl ｜ calcium carbonate CaCO₃ ｜ sulfuric acid H₂SO₄ ｜ sodium hydroxide NaOH
formulas.formula: H₂O · CO₂ · NaCl · CaCO₃ · H₂SO₄ · NaOH
formulas.cond: 正负化合价代数和为零
formulas.condEn: total positive and negative valencies sum to zero
formulas.noteCn: 书写依据：正价在前、负价在后，十字交叉确定原子个数。
formulas.noteEn: Use valencies to deduce formulae; in LC also state oxidation numbers when asked.

formulas.expr: Na⁺ ｜ K⁺ ｜ Ca²⁺ ｜ Mg²⁺ ｜ Al³⁺ ｜ Cl⁻ ｜ O²⁻ ｜ OH⁻ ｜ SO₄²⁻ ｜ CO₃²⁻ ｜ NO₃⁻ ｜ NH₄⁺
formulas.exprEn: sodium Na⁺ ｜ potassium K⁺ ｜ calcium Ca²⁺ ｜ magnesium Mg²⁺ ｜ aluminium Al³⁺ ｜ chloride Cl⁻ ｜ oxide O²⁻ ｜ hydroxide OH⁻ ｜ sulfate SO₄²⁻ ｜ carbonate CO₃²⁻ ｜ nitrate NO₃⁻ ｜ ammonium NH₄⁺
formulas.formula: cation（正离子）+ anion（负离子）→ ionic compound
formulas.cond: 离子所带电荷写在符号右上角
formulas.condEn: the charge is written as a superscript
formulas.noteCn: 爱尔兰用 sulfate / aluminium / aluminium 的拼写，不是 sulfate 美式 sulfur 混用。
formulas.noteEn: Irish exams use British spellings: sulfate, aluminium, sulphur.

formulas.expr: 碳 + 氧气 ——(点燃)→ 二氧化碳
formulas.exprEn: carbon + oxygen —(ignition)→ carbon dioxide
formulas.noteCn: 氧气充足生成 CO₂；氧气不足生成有毒的 CO。
formulas.noteEn: In limited oxygen, poisonous carbon monoxide is produced: 2C(s) + O₂(g) → 2CO(g).

formulas.expr: 镁 + 氧气 ——(点燃)→ 氧化镁
formulas.exprEn: magnesium + oxygen —(ignition)→ magnesium oxide
formulas.noteCn: 化合反应，生成白色固体氧化镁。
formulas.noteEn: A combination reaction giving a white solid. LC observation: burns with a brilliant white flame.

formulas.expr: 氢气 + 氧气 ——(点燃)→ 水
formulas.exprEn: hydrogen + oxygen —(ignition)→ water
formulas.noteCn: 产物只有水，是清洁能源。检验氢气用 burning splint 有轻微爆鸣声。
formulas.noteEn: Clean fuel producing only water. Test for hydrogen: a burning splint gives a squeaky pop.

formulas.expr: 过氧化氢 ——(二氧化锰催化)→ 水 + 氧气
formulas.exprEn: hydrogen peroxide —(manganese dioxide catalyst)→ water + oxygen
formulas.noteCn: 分解反应。MnO₂ 加快反应但本身质量和化学性质不变。
formulas.noteEn: A decomposition reaction. MnO₂ is a catalyst: it speeds up the reaction and is unchanged at the end.

formulas.expr: 高锰酸钾 ——(加热)→ 锰酸钾 + 二氧化锰 + 氧气
formulas.exprEn: potassium permanganate —(heat)→ potassium manganate(VII) + manganese dioxide + oxygen
formulas.cond: 加热；试管口略向下倾斜
formulas.condEn: heat; mouth of test tube slightly tilted down
formulas.noteCn: LC 用 potassium manganate(VII) 命名。试管口向下防止冷凝水倒流炸裂。
formulas.noteEn: LC uses potassium manganate(VII). Tilt the test tube downwards to prevent condensed water running back and cracking it.

formulas.expr: 碳酸钙 + 盐酸 → 氯化钙 + 水 + 二氧化碳
formulas.exprEn: calcium carbonate + hydrochloric acid → calcium chloride + water + carbon dioxide
formulas.cond: 常温，大理石 + 稀盐酸
formulas.condEn: room temperature, marble chips and dilute HCl
formulas.noteCn: 复分解后碳酸分解。不用硫酸（生成微溶 CaSO₄ 覆盖表面使反应停止）。
formulas.noteEn: Do not use sulfuric acid: insoluble calcium sulfate coats the marble and stops the reaction.

formulas.expr: 二氧化碳 + 氢氧化钙 → 碳酸钙↓ + 水
formulas.exprEn: carbon dioxide + calcium hydroxide → calcium carbonate + water
formulas.noteCn: 现象：石灰水变浑浊。过量 CO₂ 会使浑浊消失（生成可溶性碳酸氢钙）。
formulas.noteEn: Observation: limewater turns milky. Excess CO₂ clears the milkiness as soluble calcium hydrogencarbonate forms.

formulas.expr: 水 ——(通电)→ 氢气 + 氧气
formulas.exprEn: water —(electrolysis)→ hydrogen + oxygen
formulas.cond: 通直流电，加入少量电解质增强导电性
formulas.condEn: direct current; a little electrolyte added to conduct electricity
formulas.noteCn: 阴极（−）产生 H₂，阳极（+）产生 O₂，体积比 H₂:O₂ = 2:1。
formulas.noteEn: Hydrogen forms at the cathode (−), oxygen at the anode (+); volume ratio H₂:O₂ = 2:1.

formulas.expr: 锌 + 稀硫酸 → 硫酸锌 + 氢气
formulas.exprEn: zinc + sulfuric acid → zinc sulfate + hydrogen
formulas.noteCn: 置换反应。氢前金属能置换酸中的氢；铜等氢后金属不能。【教材校对：酸碱反应属初三内容，上海初二教材未涉及，此处为 LC 衔接预习】
formulas.noteEn: A displacement reaction. Metals above hydrogen in the reactivity series liberate H₂; copper does not.

formulas.expr: 铁 + 硫酸铜 → 硫酸亚铁 + 铜
formulas.exprEn: iron + copper(II) sulfate → iron(II) sulfate + copper
formulas.cond: 把铁钉放入硫酸铜溶液
formulas.condEn: iron nail in copper(II) sulfate solution
formulas.noteCn: 现象：铁钉表面覆盖红色铜，蓝色溶液逐渐变浅绿色。
formulas.noteEn: Observation: a reddish-brown deposit of copper forms; the blue solution turns pale green.

formulas.expr: 盐酸 + 氢氧化钠 → 氯化钠 + 水
formulas.exprEn: hydrochloric acid + sodium hydroxide → sodium chloride + water
formulas.cond: 滴加至指示剂变色（终点）
formulas.condEn: add until the indicator changes colour (end point)
formulas.noteCn: 本质离子方程式：H⁺(aq) + OH⁻(aq) → H₂O(l)。【教材校对：酸碱中和属初三内容，上海初二教材未涉及，此处为 LC 衔接预习】
formulas.noteEn: Net ionic equation: H⁺(aq) + OH⁻(aq) → H₂O(l). Na⁺ and Cl⁻ are spectator ions.

formulas.expr: 碳酸钠 + 盐酸 → 氯化钠 + 水 + 二氧化碳
formulas.exprEn: sodium carbonate + hydrochloric acid → sodium chloride + water + carbon dioxide
formulas.noteCn: 检验碳酸根：加稀盐酸产生能使石灰水变浑浊的气体。【教材校对：碳酸盐与酸属初三内容，上海初二教材未涉及，此处为 LC 衔接预习】
formulas.noteEn: Test for carbonate: add dilute acid; the gas evolved turns limewater milky.

formulas.expr: Mr = Σ(各元素的相对原子质量 × 原子个数)
formulas.exprEn: Mr = Σ (Ar × number of atoms of each element)
formulas.noteCn: 先数清每个元素的原子个数，再逐个相乘求和。
formulas.noteEn: Count atoms carefully. Molar mass has the same numerical value but units of g/mol.

keywords.cn: 相对原子 / 分子质量

formulas.expr: 某元素质量分数 = (该元素 Ar × 原子个数) ÷ Mr × 100%
formulas.exprEn: % element = (Ar × number of atoms) ÷ Mr × 100
formulas.cond: 结果保留合适有效数字
formulas.condEn: give answer to suitable significant figures
formulas.noteCn: 各元素质量分数之和约等于 100%。
formulas.noteEn: The percentages of all elements add up to approximately 100%.

formulas.expr: n = m ÷ M（n: mol；m: g；M: g/mol）
formulas.exprEn: n = m / M  (n in mol, m in g, M in g mol⁻¹)
formulas.cond: LC 计算必写公式与单位
formulas.condEn: LC requires the formula and units to be shown
formulas.noteCn: 上海初三也学，但 LC 从初二衔接起就要熟练。
formulas.noteEn: One mole contains 6.02 × 10²³ particles (Avogadro constant).

formulas.expr: c = n ÷ V（c: mol/L；n: mol；V: L）
formulas.exprEn: c = n / V  (c in mol L⁻¹, n in mol, V in L)
formulas.noteCn: 滴定计算中先求标准液物质的量，再按方程式系数比求待测液。
formulas.noteEn: In titrations, use the balanced equation to get the mole ratio before calculating concentration.

formulas.expr: 反应物总质量 = 生成物总质量
formulas.exprEn: total mass of reactants = total mass of products
formulas.cond: 有气体参加或生成时用封闭体系
formulas.condEn: use a closed system when gases are involved
formulas.noteCn: 根据方程式可求：已知一种物质质量 → 求另一种物质质量。
formulas.noteEn: Use the balanced equation: find moles of the known substance, apply the mole ratio, then convert back to mass.

formulas.expr: V = n × 22.4 L/mol（标准状况）
formulas.exprEn: V = n × 22.4 L mol⁻¹ at STP
formulas.noteCn: 与气体定律结合：P₁V₁/T₁ = P₂V₂/T₂，温度用 K。
formulas.noteEn: Combined gas law: P₁V₁/T₁ = P₂V₂/T₂; temperature must be in kelvin.
